title: Dinosaur holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Dinosaur body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <!-- Lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#81C784'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='18' ry='15' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='51' rx='12' ry='7' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='41' r='3' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='41' r='3' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='41' r='1.5' fill='#1A237E'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='41' r='1.5' fill='#1A237E'/>
  <!-- Nostrils -->
  <circle cx='47' cy='50' r='1' fill='#2E7D32'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='50' r='1' fill='#2E7D32'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M45 54 Q50 58 55 54' stroke='#2E7D32' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Spikes on back -->
  <polygon points='32,60 38,50 44,60' fill='#FF9800'/>
  <polygon points='44,58 50,46 56,58' fill='#FF9800'/>
  <polygon points='56,60 62,50 68,60' fill='#FF9800'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M28 78 Q12 70 8 82 Q14 78 28 82' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='38' y='85' width='6' height='10' rx='3' fill='#388E3C'/>
  <rect x='56' y='85' width='6' height='10' rx='3' fill='#388E3C'/>
  <!-- Arms holding heart -->
  <path d='M38 62 Q30 58 32 52' stroke='#388E3C' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 62 Q70 58 68 52' stroke='#388E3C' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Heart -->
  <path d='M50 48 C50 48 42 38 36 44 C30 50 38 60 50 68 C62 60 70 50 64 44 C58 38 50 48 50 48 Z' fill='#F44336'/>
  <!-- Heart highlight -->
  <path d='M44 46 C44 46 40 44 39 47' stroke='#FFCDD2' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
